c.h: 亻 is a component form of 人.

w: to work; (of a machine) to operate; job

關.o: Phonosemantic compound. 門 represents the meaning and 𢇇 represents the sound.

Wǒ yǒu dōngxi yào gěi nǐ.
I have something for you.
她教授东方美术史。
Tā jiàoshòu dōngfāng měishùshǐ.
She teaches Eastern art history.
我还有很多东西要学。
Wǒ hái yǒu hěn duō dōngxi yào xué.
I still have a lot to learn.

My home is far from my university.

Zhuāngjiā yǒngyuǎn shì yíngjiā.
The house always wins.

Shìshíshàng, wǒmen zài kēyán fāngmiàn yuǎnyuǎn chāoguò tāmen.

No parking — pick-up and drop-off only.

Jìnzhǐ chēliàng tíngliú.
No stopping.

w: capital city of an autonomous region
(orig.) tents forming the offices of a commanding officer

Yīngguó zhèngfǔ píng shénme yào gānshè?
On what authority can the British government interfere?
你去过市政府吗？

Have you been to the city hall?

Yínchuān shì Níngxiàhuízúzìzhìqū de shǒufǔ.

Tāmen dōu láizì nóngcūn.
They are all from the countryside.

我不想辜负父母的期望。
